english: The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
text: as near as she could 不报一个固定距离，而是说明她已尽可能贴近孩子。表达受条件限制的最大努力，可说 as close as possible 或 as near as you can；这里随后写箱子太小，具体显出努力的限度。
